lines.en: Here I sit in shrink wrap, left alone to rot. To suffocate and die before I’m stuffed into a pot.
Today, my bones will be the soup. My skin will be the broth. My hair will be the garnish and my cum will be the froth-
That coats the throats of goats and lambs, they’ll feed me to the farm. But I’ve yet to please the FDA, so there’s a chance I might bring harm-
Disease/a plague/a parasite - the maddest of all cows. Never once have I been human, never once have I been proud.
To be what she has made of me. Ingredients, at best. A specimen — this mess I’m in won’t ever let me rest.
Howdy.
You’ll never guess where I am right now.
: Papa?
: Aren’t you going to come into the bath with Chinami?
: No.
: Why?
: Because this is already a step further than I planned on going today.
: Several steps, actually. So you’ll just have to deal with me looking away until you’re ready to come out.
: But Chinami’s arms! They’re not bendy enough!
: Then neither are mine.
We’re here. And I haven’t done anything wrong. At least not yet.
But the fact that I am here means that I could. That I might. That I want to. But I don’t want to want to. So I want to stop wanting that.
What I want rarely seems to matter at all anymore, though. At least not when there are creatures who do and don’t exist pulling me into places where they know that I’ll get lost.
This is one of those places — a battle I’ve already returned from once. But it feels more like a suicide mission when I need to face it alone this time.
It’s innocent enough. And for anyone worth more than me, I’m sure it would be fine. It’d be like being sent out to take down a single spider with a barrel full of dynamite.
But someone lit my hands on fire a long, long time ago. And now I can’t carry anything without the risk of burning or igniting it.
: Is Papa only uncomfortable because Chinami is a girl?
: One day, Chinami’s going to stop asking questions I don’t know how to answer without incriminating myself.
: She probably won’t. Chinami is a curious girl. There are all sorts of things she wants to learn more about.
: One day, Chinami will also stop saying things that incriminate her.
: Is it wrong for Chinami to think about love sometimes?
: What?
: That’s what Papa was fighting about with Chinami’s big sisters, wasn’t it?
: Big sis Chika has been talking in her sleep again. She says that you love more than one person. Was she mad because you love big sis Yumi too?
: I don’t love Yumi.
: You just want to do naughty stuff with her then?
: Wha- why is that a thing you even know about?
: Chinami watched Game of Thrones, remember? And even if big sis Chika closed her eyes for the naughty parts, Chinami knows they exist.
: Has Papa been doing naughty things with big sis Yumi?
: No. Now, change the subject.
: But he’s been doing naughty things with big sis Chika, right?
: I can’t talk about this with you.
: Why?
: Because you’re too young. And your sister would kill me.
: I don’t think she would, Papa. People are allowed to do naughty things together when they love each other.
: And since you love big sis Chika, Chinami is okay with you doing as many naughty things as you like!
: Shut up...
: But she doesn’t really understand how those naughty things work yet since her eyes are always closed. So she hopes that someone will-
: Shut up!
: Oh no! Talking about naughty stuff made Papa mad at Chinami again!
: Chinami is sorry. She just wants to understand and all of this stuff is super confusing to her.
: I’m not...mad. You don’t know any better yet. But if this is something you really want to learn about, you should talk to your sister. Not me.
: But if Chinami talks to big sis Chika about that, she’ll get sad that Chinami is growing up. So Chinami needs to stay Chinami. That’s what’s best for everyone right now.
: Yeah well, Chinami’s clearly not smart enough to know what’s best for anyone right now if she’s going to put herself into situations like this.
: Does Papa think Chinami has ulterior motives?
: He thinks Chinami should stop referring to herself in third person before bringing up serious topics like this.
: Chinami will do that so long as Papa promises to keep it a secret.
: Yeah, whatever. This whole day should be kept a secret as far as I’m concerned.
: Which sister do you like more then? Is onee-chan right that she’s winning? Or do you like delinquent girls like Yumi more?
: Or maybe I’m your type and that’s why you’re afraid to get in the bath with me.
: If I had to choose between all three of you...Chika would come out on top.
: Mm. That’s the right answer. She loves you the most, after all.
: But Chinami doesn’t-
: You’re doing it again.
: Oh. Sorry. Habit.
: What I don’t understand is why onee-chan would be so sad if you loved Yumi the way you love her.
: How is that a thing you’re confused about? You watch TV. You play games. You practically live on your phone. I’m sure you know all about the conventional definition of “love” by now.
: But there’s conflicting information everywhere, Papa! Everybody has an opinion on what kind of love is “wrong” and what kind of love is “right.”
: And that’s the part that’s confusing to me because I’m hearing from the same people who say those things that love is different for everyone. So why do some people get to choose what’s wrong?
: Like...maybe relationships are just all about two people with the same definition of love finding each other? Does that make any sense?
: I think you just answered your own question.
: Hm?
: Your sister’s upset because she believed we had the same definition. And I told her the last time I came over that we didn’t.
: Oohhhhhhh, okay. I think I get it now. You’re like Jaime Lannister. And Chika is Cersei Lannister and Yumi is Brienne of Tarth.
: I have no idea what you just said.
: Cersei and Brienne both love Jaime and Jaime loves both of them, but his love for Cersei outweighs his feelings for Brienne, so he always goes back to her.
: But then that makes Brienne sad because she never gets a chance to act on her feelings — which leaves Jaime with the feeling of longing until-
: Are you going to watch it? Because I don’t want to spoil what happens if you’re going to watch it.
: Probably not, Chinami.
: I’m not gonna spoil it anyway just to be safe. Chika says spoilers are bad. But the gist is that love triangles always make somebody upset and you’re the tip of your own triangle.
: That’s fair. I should just probably also mention that triangle is situated neatly inside a shape with so many sides that I’m not even sure if there’s a name for it.
: Then, is Chika winning that competition too? Or just the tinier triangle with her and Yumi in it?
: Chinami won’t tell on you if that’s what you’re worried about. She’s an expert at gossip now.
: But clearly not an expert at maintaining a regular speech pattern.
: Okay, you try spending your entire life talking in third person and then having to switch for an entire conversation. It’s harder than it sounds, Papa.
: Can you call me Akira instead? That’s my actual name.
: No.
: That was a pretty instantaneous rejection. May I ask why?
: How come you’re allowed to ask “why?” but I get in trouble whenever I do it?
: Because I do it when I genuinely want to know something and you do it for the sole purpose of annoying me.
: That’s what daughters are for! Probably. I’ve never had a dad, so I don’t really know.
: You’re a weird girl, Chinami. But surprisingly bearable when you’re not persuading me to do things I’m uncomfortable with.
: Thank you! Does that mean you’ll get in the bath with me now?
: Did you listen to my last sentence at all? Or did you just stop after the part where I called you bearable?
: I was listening. I just think you’re making too big of a deal out of being uncomfortable and I want help washing my hair.
: I’m in my 30’s. I’m not getting into the bath with a little girl no matter how much she wants me to.
: Then Chinami will just assume that Papa is a lolicon and that he wants to do naughty things to her while her sister is away at work. Papa is a bad boy.
: Kidding.
: Wow. You really are uncomfortable, aren’t you?
: I’m not proud of it, Chinami.
: I don’t want to be like this.
: Then Chinami will switch back to regular Chinami so it’s easier for Papa to remember his role as Papa and not her sister’s lolicon boyfriend!
: Where did you even learn that word?
: Big sis Yumi accidentally taught Chinami lots of bad words. But Chinami isn’t going to use them right now because Papa’s in a pickle!
: I think I’m going to head back out into the living room now.
: No! Papa is going to wash Chinami’s hair because Chinami is sick and he needs to do what she commands of him.
: I’m not getting into the bath with you. It’s not happening.
: Then stay out there.
: Chinami will come close to you.
: Nihihihi~
: Chinami knew it was only a matter of time until Papa caved. Now, she gets to enjoy a nice scalp massage while he fights his inner demons!
: Right now, those demons are telling me to drown you in the bathtub.
: But then you’d never get to see the grown up Chinami who won’t make you feel bad for wanting to do naughty things.
: You’d still be my “girlfriend’s” sister either way. Which means that any feelings I ever have involving you won’t be good ones.
: Does that mean you’ll be my Papa forever, then?
: That’s what it means if you’re still with big sis Chika many years from now, right?
: Will Papa get jealous if Chinami ever gets a boyfriend?
: Will he try to scare them away in order to protect her?
: Or will Chinami have to stay single forever so Papa won’t be sad?
: Don’t look up at me like that, please.
: Why not? I’m having a cute moment with my daddy. It’s not my fault he’s a lolicon.
: Well, you’re certainly not helping.
: Is there any way Chinami can help?
: Yes. By not capitalizing on my weaknesses and coercing me into doing things like this.
: Chinami learned from her friend Tsukasa that capitalizing on someone’s weakness is the quickest way to get what you want.
: I knew that girl was going to be a bad influence on you.
: Maybe next time, all three of us can take a bath together and really put Papa in a tight spot!
: Now I really want to drown you.
: Chinamiiii!~ I’m home early!~
: Oh. You’re-
: Welcome home, big sis Chika!
: Are you...
: What are you doing?
: Are you...washing her hair?
: She made me do it. I tried to stay out there. But she just kept-
: KYAAAAAAAAH! OHMYGOD! THIS IS THE CUTEST THING I’VE EVER SEEN IN MY LIFE! IT’S LIKE WE’RE AN ACTUAL FAMILY! OHMYGOD OHMYGOD OHMYGOD!
: Uhh...
: LET ME GRAB A CHANGE OF CLOTHES AND I’LL GET IN THE BATH TOO! OHMYGOD! I’M SO IN LOVE!
: Do you think big sis Chika is a lolicon too?
: I think you should never repeat that word in front of her for as long as you live.
I bail out before Chika makes it into the bathroom again.
Just being in there with Chinami was hard enough. And knowing who I am, I...I’m not sure if I’d be able to handle both of them at once.
Regardless, it seems like my job here is done.
Chinami will survive for at least one more day.
And I-
And I will go to sleep undeserving of the same.
Chinami’s affection has increased to [chinami_love]!
Chika’s affection has increased to [chika_love]!
